    rst: The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.

module lfsr_8bit(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire [7:0] seed,
    input wire start,
    output reg [7:0] rand_num
);

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            rand_num <= seed;
        end
        else if (start) begin
            rand_num <= {rand_num[6:0], rand_num[7] ^ rand_num[5]};
        end
    end
endmodule
